The pen from Record another, cropped through the Tasting head. At the machine and Ingredient notes come first, above the field; Ingredient notes' underline is the one rule above At draw, which draws no hairline of its own. At draw heads Exit consistency and Airiness, the last two fields of the section. A pick hides the two fields and shows Clear; the notes stay above, and the Tasting head follows the field. A mark keeps the field and turns its options off, with the reason beside the name; a note changes nothing.
